basePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production inventory illustration for AGGRO, a darkly comic dungeon game set in a ruined corporate warehouse. Create ONE polished, hand-painted game item with convincing 3D form, crisp silhouette, tactile metal/leather/glass surfaces, restrained wear, and beautifully controlled highlights. This is high-quality collectible equipment art, grounded and practical. Studio-like warm key light from upper left, a subtle magenta edge light, no excessive glow. Real transparent background with alpha, no backdrop, no floor, no card frame, no text or watermark, no people, no hands. Square composition. Entire object visible, centered, occupying about 80–86% of the square, safe padding on every side. Fine detail at full size but unmistakable silhouette at 64 pixels. The object must match the description exactly and have clean construction. Subject:

assets.name: Dagger
assets.subject: A short, broad steel warehouse knife, dark wood grip tightly wrapped in tan cord, plain bolster, diagonal grip lower left to point upper right. No gems or magical spikes.
